title: Average Precision
signature: def average_precision(y_true: np.ndarray, scores: np.ndarray) -> float
hints: Sort by score, highest first. Lowering the threshold past each distinct score adds a group of samples to the predicted positives.
Cumulative sums of the sorted labels give TP at every cutoff. Precision = TP / (number predicted), recall = TP / (total positives).
Tied scores form one threshold: evaluate only at the last index of each run of equal scores. Then AP = sum of (recall jump) * precision.
